assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production background image for the home menu of the game 小羊快跑.
Input image 1 is the edit target and style reference.
Create a clean 16:9 landscape background by removing ALL foreground UI and ALL sheep from the attached image: remove the large central wooden title board, its subtitle, the sheep above that title and the sheep standing in the middle, the top-left settings button, the top-right high score plaque and crown, the bottom-center start button, and the bottom-right wardrobe button. Reconstruct those areas with continuous natural scenery. Keep the picturesque sunlit pixel-art farmland: cyan blue sky and fluffy ivory clouds, distant layered green mountains, blue lake, trees on the far left, rustic windmill and red barn on the right, wooden fences, meadow flowers, stones and the horizontal warm sandy path at about 73% image height. Keep the middle of the sky open so a separate title can be drawn there. Keep a clear grassy space in the center above the path for a separate sheep sprite. Preserve the fine hand-painted pixel-art texture, crisp stepped edges, bright turquoise sky, lush yellow-green foliage, warm amber wood, and warm light of the reference. This must be only the beautiful scenery, no UI, no typography, no characters, no sheep, no buttons, no plaques, no logo, no watermarks. 1920x1080 landscape composition.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: horizontally scrolling environment artwork for 小羊快跑.
Input image 1 is the runner layout to preserve. Input image 2 is the style reference to match.
Repaint the runner landscape in the FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL PIXEL CARTOON illustration style of image 2. The user explicitly does NOT want volumetric forms, modeled 3D objects, 3D-to-2D cel rendering, ambient occlusion or a 3D game look. Use charming flat 2D painted pixel-art shapes, stepped pixel edges, restrained simple highlights, dense small illustrated grass/flower details and the bright cyan, green, yellow and warm wood colors of image 2. Keep atmospheric distance layers but do not add 3D volume. Trees are flat clusters of pixel leaves; buildings are simple illustrated farmhouse shapes; clouds are flat painted cream pixel shapes.
Keep image 1's composition: blue sky and distant mountains in upper half; lake and pasture in the middle; small windmill, cottage and barn at the right, scattered flat 2D shrubs and flowers, foreground wooden fence; flat green grass lip at 80% image height followed by broad clear golden dirt road to the bottom. Side-view game lane with a fully unobstructed horizontal running surface. Do not place giant near trees at the outer edges. All objects stay behind the lane. Both left and right boundaries have matching sky/grass/ground heights for horizontal repeating. This is only the environment: no sheep, characters, UI, buttons, typography or watermarks. Preserve exact wide 16:9 layout.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: far-distance parallax environment layer for 小羊快跑.
Input image 1 is the far-background composition. Input image 2 is the exact requested style.
Repaint image 1 to match image 2's detailed TWO-DIMENSIONAL PIXEL CARTOON farmland style exactly: fine stepped pixel edges and tiny hand-painted pixel textures, cream pixel clouds, blue-green illustrated mountains, fresh green flat fields, cyan sky and blue sparkling lake. Use the visual style of image 2 rather than modeled 3D shading. Preserve image 1's composition, mountain skyline, clouds and lake positions; all remaining lower areas are clean distant grassy hills. No near buildings, no windmill, no barns, no foreground fences, no close large trees, no close flowers and no dirt running lane. This layer will sit behind separate foreground scenery. All outer edges match for seamless horizontal scrolling. The entire full 16:9 canvas is opaque scenery with sky in upper half and fields continuing to the bottom. No UI, text, characters or watermarks.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: aligned transparent near-scenery layer for 小羊快跑 parallax backgrounds.
Input image is the edit target. Extract only its CLOSE scenery to a genuinely transparent PNG. Preserve the full exact original canvas dimensions and every object's original position, scale, pixels, textures and TWO-DIMENSIONAL PIXEL CARTOON art style. Do not recenter, crop, resize, reframe or change the layout.
RETAIN EXACTLY: close trees and bushes in front of lake; windmill, cottage and red barn at right; close rolling grassy flower meadows; both wooden fence sections; foreground grass/hedge strip; ALL sandy dirt road across full width to bottom.
REMOVE TO TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA: sky, clouds, far blue-green mountains, distant forests and entire open blue lake. Follow irregular foreground silhouettes of trees, grass, buildings and windmill blades accurately. Preserve gaps through windmill blades as transparency. Top half is fully transparent. Lower near meadow silhouette begins at about half height and the bottom hedge and dirt lane are fully opaque across the whole width. Exact wide 16:9 image alignment. No 3D rendering or volume added. No new objects. No UI, text, characters, watermark. Output true transparent alpha, not white and not a printed checkerboard.
